title: Why Does Your Toilet Keep Running? #Shorts
description:
Blue thinks someone is watching his toilet. Orange explains the real boss: a floating ball on an arm that opens the valve when you flush and pushes it shut at the same line every time. Plus why yours keeps running at night (a float set too high or a worn valve sends the extra water down the overflow tube).

Explained in 60, podcast edition
